title: New in Symfony 8.2: Cache Improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>The Cache component stores the results of expensive operations in many
backends: files, Redis, Valkey, Memcached, databases, etc. Symfony 8.2 makes it
simpler to choose that backend, makes cache tags faster when using a database
and reports a kind of failure…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
